entities.summary: Bobo of S. Teodoro was a prominent Roman entrepreneur and religious figure of the Classical era, active in Rome from approximately 1150 to 1199. His business acumen and connections to the Roman Church enabled him to accumulate wealth and influence, which he used to support various charitable endeavors and philanthropic causes. Through his relationships with prominent figures of the time, Bobo played a significant role in shaping the spiritual and cultural landscape of Rome during this period. A testament to his enduring legacy, the Church of S. Teodoro, built in his honor, remains a revered landmark in the city to this day.
